title: Has great potential
body:
I love it but didn’t rely it on it before. now it is connected to my gmail calendar, so I’m coming back to it. But I wish it has a Ai component that allows me to either speak to it or just type in my  weekly activities and let it sort them into tasks instead of manually entering each task. 
I use Gemini as a personal assistant where I share my schedules or plans and it sorts them into tasks, but can’t update them into this app. So
Yh, I think there’s potential to make this app more productive
author: Awumboro

title: Excellent app but can't see all tasks from multiple emails
body:
This app is great and helps with organising your schedule. Kudos to the team.

However, I am unable to share tasks from one email to another just as calendar events does. I wish to be able to see all work and home tasks to have a better schedule of the day. Great to be able to share tasks from one email to another.

Also if a task is created from an email, can that task be added to tasks of a particular chat room. This will also be very helpful as a task assigned from an email might be applicable for a particular chat room.
author: nattieab
